name: Alternative Therapy
description: Selva is an eccentric relationship counselor who has made a name for herself with her unorthodox sessions. But Selva’s career hits a roadblock when she takes on Elías and Malena, a young couple who are seeking guidance on how to separate.

videos.title: The Perfect Couple
videos.overview: Relationship counselor Selva Pérez Salerno – known as the “Love Guru” on TV – suffers a professional setback after one of her therapy sessions goes offcourse.

videos.title: Marcelo Football
videos.overview: Malena and Elías sit down for their first session with Selva, where they explain how their relationship first came to be and the reasoning as to why they can’t end it.

videos.title: How to Make Your Life Suck Less
videos.overview: Selva oversteps her professional boundaries by going to visit Elías and Malena at the showroom. Acting on Selva’s treatment recommendation, the couple decides to redecorate the place, which results in a controversial outcome.

videos.title: Never Ever
videos.overview: Elías and Malena fail yet again to meet the weekly therapy goal Selva set for them.

videos.title: Aunt Evelyn
videos.overview: Unexpected news forces Selva to return to her hometown, where she struggles to deal with her parents, relatives, her small-time fame and the rumors that come from a place that she loves and hates with equal passion.

videos.title: The Home of My Sidepiece
videos.overview: Selva returns to her job with renewed energy and lays out a new therapy directive for Elías and Malena that proves to be more revealing than she could have imagined.

videos.title: The Last Dinner
videos.overview: Elías and Malena are reunited at an unexpected dinner – each with their new partners. Despite a calm start, the mood turns sour and the whole evening goes off the rails.

videos.title: Fear Is Something Else
videos.overview: Selva’s therapy requirement ends with Elías and Malena visited by an unexpected person who pushes their relationship to a point of no return.

videos.title: Selva
videos.overview: Selva relishes in the success of her therapy, but the other side of the equation is a different story – Elías’ new reality leaves him a broken man while Malena struggles to overcome the separation.

videos.title: Loving What You Desire
videos.overview: Selva comes full circle with her lie and opts to cut all ties at her book unveiling. With the whereabouts of the two lovers known, their next chapter remains uncertain.

videos.title: Speak Now or Forever Hold Your Peace
